$comment: MSE structs. RULES: (1) required fields are positional and frozen for the life of MWP/1; (2) optional fields carry a stable id, may be added any time, and are skippable by old peers; (3) never reuse an optional id.

structs.name: ClientInfo
structs.doc: Who is connecting. Used for feature gating and abuse triage, never for tracking.

structs.name: ResumeRequest
structs.doc: Resume an existing session instead of a full re-sync.

structs.name: Hello
structs.doc: First frame on every connection.

fields.name: features
fields.doc: Client feature bitmask; the session uses the intersection with the server's

fields.name: access_token
fields.doc: Saves a round trip: authenticate inside HELLO

structs.name: Limits
structs.doc: Server-dictated limits. The client must respect these, not its own constants.

fields.name: authenticated_user
fields.doc: Present when HELLO carried a valid access token

fields.name: public_id
fields.doc: MGO-XXXXXXXX, immutable, shareable

fields.name: avatar_media_id
fields.doc: The avatar media object; clients fetch a short-lived URL for it.

fields.name: capabilities
fields.doc: Capability bitmask for this session

structs.name: Error
structs.doc: Carried with the ERROR flag on any opcode, or standalone.

fields.name: symbol
fields.doc: Stable machine-readable symbol; clients localise from this, never from message

fields.name: message
fields.doc: Developer-facing detail. Never shown verbatim to users

fields.name: field
fields.doc: Offending field for validation errors

fields.name: client_time
fields.doc: Echoed so the client can compute RTT without keeping state

structs.name: Ack
structs.doc: Cumulative watermark. One ACK retires every held frame at or below it.

structs.name: ReconnectHint
structs.doc: Planned drain. after_ms is randomised per session to avoid a thundering herd.

fields.name: message_id
fields.doc: Client-generated ULID. Makes retry idempotent

fields.name: envelope
fields.doc: E2E ciphertext for private conversations; MSE room payload for rooms

fields.name: expires_in_ms
fields.doc: Disappearing messages

fields.name: duplicate
fields.doc: True when dedup matched an earlier send. Success, not an error

fields.name: deleted
fields.doc: Tombstone, so offline clients converge instead of keeping ghosts

fields.name: seq
fields.doc: Cumulative: everything up to seq is delivered/read

fields.name: have_seq
fields.doc: Highest contiguous seq the client holds

fields.name: to_seq
fields.doc: Ranged fetch for a detected gap

fields.name: backwards
fields.doc: Paging older history

structs.name: ConversationCreateRequest
structs.doc: Direct conversations are deterministic in their member set, so creation is idempotent.

structs.name: KeyPublish
structs.doc: Public halves only. The server never receives private key material.

fields.name: identity_fingerprint
fields.doc: Shown in the UI for out-of-band verification

fields.name: device_id
fields.doc: Omit to fetch a bundle for every device of the user

fields.name: max_members
fields.doc: The room's capacity ceiling; join is refused once member_count reaches it.

fields.name: change
fields.doc: Why the membership changed. Absent on legacy join/leave, where `joined` says it.

structs.name: RoomStateEvent
structs.doc: Coalesced room counters and metadata. Deltas only.

fields.name: max_members
fields.doc: The room's capacity ceiling, sent when it changes.

structs.name: NotificationEvent
structs.doc: Never carries private plaintext. Push payloads are generic (brief 77).

structs.name: GameAction
structs.doc: An intent. The server decides the outcome (brief 89).

fields.name: action_id
fields.doc: Monotonic per game per player; replays are detected

fields.name: payload
fields.doc: Delta, never a full state snapshot

fields.name: text
fields.doc: Pre-rendered bot line for thin clients

structs.name: FriendTarget
structs.doc: A single subject account for a social action.

structs.name: SocialSuggestReq
structs.doc: Request for people the caller might know.

structs.name: SocialSuggestions
structs.doc: Suggested account ids.

structs.name: MediaBegin
structs.doc: Open an upload ticket for a media object.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: Content kind, from the media domain enum

fields.name: size
fields.doc: Declared total bytes

fields.name: conversation_id
fields.doc: Present for conversation-scoped media; absent for profile media

structs.name: MediaTicket
structs.doc: Signed upload URL and the ticket that claims the object later.

fields.name: headers
fields.doc: Headers the client must send with the PUT

fields.name: digest
fields.doc: SHA-256 of the uploaded bytes

structs.name: WalletReq
structs.doc: Empty request; the caller's own wallet is implied by the session.

fields.name: gift
fields.doc: SKU slug

structs.name: CatalogueReq
structs.doc: Empty request for the gift catalogue.

fields.name: token
fields.doc: Present only on register/rotate; never logged

fields.name: subject_kind
fields.doc: 0 user, 1 message, 2 room, 3 bot

structs.name: ProfileUpdate
structs.doc: A profile patch: every field optional, absent means leave alone.

fields.name: display_name
fields.doc: New display name, or absent to leave it.

fields.name: bio
fields.doc: New bio, or absent to leave it.

fields.name: avatar_media_id
fields.doc: New avatar object, or absent to leave it.

fields.name: birth_year
fields.doc: New birth year, or absent.

fields.name: show_last_seen
fields.doc: New last-seen visibility.

fields.name: who_can_message
fields.doc: New messaging visibility.

fields.name: who_can_add
fields.doc: New friend-request visibility.

fields.name: searchable
fields.doc: New search visibility.

structs.name: MessageEdit
structs.doc: Edits a message in place: the sealed replacement envelope, preserving its seq.

fields.name: envelope
fields.doc: The sealed replacement content, opaque to the server.

structs.name: ReactionSet
structs.doc: Sets or removes the caller's reaction to a message.

fields.name: envelope
fields.doc: The sealed reaction content, opaque to the server.

structs.name: SuggestReq
structs.doc: Asks for friend suggestions.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: Maximum suggestions; server clamps.

structs.name: SuggestedUser
structs.doc: One suggested account.

structs.name: SearchReq
structs.doc: Searches public profiles by username or display name.

structs.name: SearchResponse
structs.doc: Search results.

structs.name: ReactionEvent
structs.doc: A reaction was added or removed on a message.

fields.name: remove
fields.doc: True when the reaction was removed.

structs.name: RoomCreate
structs.doc: Creates a room; the caller becomes its Owner.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: RoomKind: 1=Public, 2=Managed.

structs.name: RosterEntry
structs.doc: One member of a room's roster.

fields.name: role
fields.doc: RoomRole.

structs.name: RosterReq
structs.doc: Reads a room's roster, highest role first.

fields.name: after
fields.doc: Cursor: the last account_id of the previous page.

structs.name: RosterResponse
structs.doc: A page of a room's roster.

structs.name: RoomRoleSet
structs.doc: Changes a member's role.

fields.name: role
fields.doc: RoomRole.

structs.name: RoomUpdate
structs.doc: Updates a room's settings.

structs.name: RoomArchive
structs.doc: Archives a room; only its Owner (or staff).

structs.name: RoomVoteKick
structs.doc: Starts a kick vote, or adds the caller's voice to one already running.

structs.name: RoomVoteKickResponse
structs.doc: The vote's state after the caller's voice landed.

fields.name: votes
fields.doc: Voices cast for the kick, the caller's included.

fields.name: needed
fields.doc: Half the room's members, rounded up.

fields.name: open
fields.doc: False once the vote passed and the kick landed; the tally that follows is the room's MemberChange.

structs.name: RoomVoteEvent
structs.doc: A running kick vote's tally, coalesced per room.

fields.name: closed
fields.doc: True when the vote ended without passing (expired, or the target left).

structs.name: RoomSanction
structs.doc: One moderation action on one member: mute, kick, ban, or their undoing.

structs.name: MuteSet
structs.doc: Mutes or unmutes one account for the caller; a personal choice, not a room's.

structs.name: GameStart
structs.doc: Starts a game in a conversation.

fields.name: slug
fields.doc: Which game to start, from the catalogue.

structs.name: GameViewWire
structs.doc: A game's state as one caller sees it.

structs.name: GameId
structs.doc: Identifies one game.

structs.name: GameCatalogueEntry
structs.doc: One game in the catalogue.

structs.name: GameCatalogueResponse
structs.doc: The games this node can play.

structs.name: GiftCatalogueReq
structs.doc: Empty; the catalogue is the node's own.

structs.name: GiftCatalogueResponse
structs.doc: The gift catalogue.

structs.name: LedgerReq
structs.doc: Reads the caller's statement.

structs.name: LedgerEntryWire
structs.doc: One line of the caller's statement.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc: Magnitude; the reason's direction is the sign.

structs.name: LedgerResponse
structs.doc: A page of the caller's statement.

structs.name: ProgressionReq
structs.doc: Reads one account's XP, level, and progress bar.

structs.name: ProgressionWire
structs.doc: XP standing and the progress bar.

structs.name: BadgeWire
structs.doc: One badge an account holds.

structs.name: BadgesReq
structs.doc: Reads one account's badges.

structs.name: BadgesResponse
structs.doc: The badges an account holds.

structs.name: LeaderboardReq
structs.doc: Reads a leaderboard.

fields.name: board
fields.doc: Which board; e.g. 'xp' or 'reputation'.

structs.name: RankWire
structs.doc: One line of a leaderboard.

structs.name: LeaderboardResponse
structs.doc: A leaderboard page.

structs.name: CallInvite
structs.doc: Invites a callee to a call.

fields.name: call_id
fields.doc: Client-minted; also the idempotency key.

fields.name: media_kind
fields.doc: 0=Audio, 1=Video.

fields.name: capabilities
fields.doc: Codec and feature negotiation.

fields.name: sealed_offer
fields.doc: E2E-sealed SDP offer; the server never reads it.

structs.name: CallInviteResult
structs.doc: The caller's answer to its own invite.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: 0=Ringing, 1=Declined, 2=Expired, 3=Blocked.

structs.name: CallInviteEvent
structs.doc: Tells the callee a call is ringing.

structs.name: CallAnswer
structs.doc: The callee answers.

fields.name: sealed_answer
fields.doc: E2E-sealed SDP answer.

structs.name: CallDecline
structs.doc: The callee declines.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: 0=Busy, 1=Declined.

structs.name: CallCancel
structs.doc: The caller cancels before an answer.

structs.name: CallEnd
structs.doc: Ends an established call; always with a reason.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: 0=ByCaller, 1=ByCallee, 2=Declined, 3=NoAnswer, 4=Failed, 5=Network.

structs.name: CallSdp
structs.doc: Relays a sealed SDP offer or answer between devices.

fields.name: sealed_sdp
fields.doc: E2E-sealed SDP blob.

structs.name: CallIce
structs.doc: Relays a batch of sealed ICE candidates.

fields.name: sealed_candidates
fields.doc: A batch of sealed ICE candidates, not one frame per candidate.

structs.name: CallStateEvent
structs.doc: A call's state change, pushed to participants.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: 0=Ringing, 1=Connecting, 2=Connected, 3=Reconnecting, 4=Ended.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: Present when state is Ended.

structs.name: CallRenegotiate
structs.doc: Renegotiates codecs/streams mid-call (e.g. ICE restart, add video).

structs.name: CallKeyUpdate
structs.doc: Re-keys the call's media encryption (e.g. membership change).

structs.name: CallStats
structs.doc: Aggregate quality numbers; Droppable; never call content.

structs.name: TurnServer
structs.doc: One TURN relay with short-lived credentials.

structs.name: CallTurnFetch
structs.doc: Requests TURN credentials for a call.

structs.name: CallTurnResponse
structs.doc: TURN servers with temporary credentials.

structs.name: CallId
structs.doc: Identifies one call.

structs.name: MlDsaChallenge
structs.doc: The bytes an ML-DSA login ceremony signs: issued over REST, MSE-encoded by the server, signed by the client exactly as received so no port re-encodes it differently. Single use, short lived, bound to one account, device and purpose.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc: The account the challenge authenticates

fields.name: device_id
fields.doc: The device the challenge is bound to; for add-device, the new device

fields.name: challenge_id
fields.doc: Server-side handle; single use — the first answer consumes it

fields.name: nonce
fields.doc: 32 bytes from the server CSPRNG; never derived from anything the client controls

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc: Five minutes after issuance

fields.name: server_region
fields.doc: Deployment identity, so a challenge from one deployment cannot be answered at another
